title: France - Install French localization as an extension to the base app

en.title: France - Install French localization as an extension to the base app
en.summary: The localized version for France is now available as a set of extensions on the W1 base app. This version includes a data upgrade feature to simplify the transition from the previous localization. This release moves the product closer to full delocalization, so ISVs can reach a wider market. Some features move to the base app or become global apps, while others stay specific to the French market.
